title: The Dockyard Mousers
logline: An imported breed of predatory martens eliminates cargo vermin in the docks but begins hunting the delicate pollinators in the habitat's heritage aviary.

roles.description: Head of the cargo gang; fiercely protective of the hunting martens that cleaned up the rat-infested holds.
Curator of the station's hydroponic bird sanctuary; horrified by the loss of irreplaceable pollinator stock.
Responsible for commercial habitat balances; terrified of paying pest fines or losing agricultural yields.
The domed botanical aviary housing the station's delicate seed-dispersing finches.
Padded atmospheric transport carriers designed for humane live trapping.

public_situation: Dockworkers celebrate the extermination of hold-boring beetles by imported martens, while agricultural technicians report the predators have breached the botanical aviary.
private_truth: The quartermaster approved the predator import without habitat quarantine clearance to avoid spending station maintenance reserves on chemical fumigation.

beats.public_change: The botanical aviary seals its air vents after three rare seed-finches are found mauled near the ventilation shafts.

missions.reason: The warden needs an outsider with sensor gear to scan the station air ducts to locate the martens' nesting den without alerting the defensive dockers.
missions.private_fact: She knows the pollinators were already struggling with genetic inbreeding and cannot survive even a week of active predation.

beats.public_change: Dockers threaten an unscheduled shift slowdown if station administration attempts to cull or poison the martens.

missions.reason: The bosun hires a neutral pilot to recover custom pheromone scent lures from a supply locker to draw the martens back down into the freight bays.
missions.private_fact: The dockers have been secretly feeding the martens prime ration meat to keep them docile and loyal to the maintenance crew.

beats.public_change: The station quartermaster authorizes an emergency resolution before the agricultural yield drops below lease requirements.

missions.reason: The quartermaster contracts the pilot to transport live containment cages to the aviary to settle the dispute once and for all.
missions.private_fact: The quartermaster will quietly sell whichever species is removed to an exotic menagerie trader in the next system.

player_choice.prompt: The trapped animals are caged at the dock. The pilot must decide where the carriers are dispatched.

options.label: Ship the predators off-station to preserve the aviary
Release the predators in the freight hold and relocate surviving birds
Hand both species to the quartermaster's quiet buyer

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot evacuates the martens off-station, securing the aviary.
resolutions.summary: {role:sanctuary_warden} saves the seed-finch flock, but hold beetles return within a month, forcing {role:station_quartermaster} to fund costly fumigation.

consequences.public_summary: A hauler cleared out invasive predators, saving the station's rare pollinators.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot releases the martens back to the freight decks and shelters them from eradication.
resolutions.summary: {role:dock_bosun} keeps the freight bays vermin-free, but the wild aviary collapses, forcing the habitat to import artificial pollinators.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot backed the cargo gang, letting invasive mousers overrun a heritage bird sanctuary.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands over the animals to the quartermaster for commercial liquidation.
resolutions.summary: {role:station_quartermaster} sells both the rare finches and trained martens to an outside broker, leaving the station with pests and no birds.
Martens wipe out the aviary before dockers poison the water supply accidentally, leaving {role:sanctuary_warden} destitute.

loose_threads.detail: The quarantine manifest for the marten transport lists the importer as an agricultural investment trust that was liquidated three years ago.
Each cage bears an inspection seal with a serial code matching a batch of chemical fumigant canisters that vanished from the orbital agricultural depot.

radio_hooks: Dockworkers credit imported predators with record drop in hold grain spoilage.
Botanical society appeals for emergency intervention as rare finch numbers plummet in {system}.
Station administration declines to comment on unauthorized animal introductions.

voice_direction.dock_bosun: Rough, defensive, and fond of animal metaphors. Never admits that his crew failed to check the ventilation grates.
voice_direction.sanctuary_warden: Precise, anxious, and uses Latin species designations when stressed. Never speaks directly to the dockworkers.
voice_direction.station_quartermaster: Slick, hurried, and perpetually calculating maintenance ledger margins. Changes the subject whenever quarantine certification is mentioned.
